spec:
Answer, with hython/command-line evidence on this machine (Houdini Indie 22.0.466; H21.0.596 is also installed if useful), the questions D11 needs to choose how nodes ship. Output: docs/design/packaging-spike.md, with a recommendation (HDA vs Python-SOP fallback vs hybrid). Each claim cites a check script under docs/design/evidence/packaging/ plus its output, or a docs page read via the docs tool.
1. Saving an HDA from this Indie install: what file/licence category results (.hda vs .hdalc; hou.licenseCategory, the asset's licence intrinsics)? What happens to a .hip / session (FX, Indie, Apprentice semantics per SideFX docs) that loads it?
2. Source build: can an HDA be expanded to a text directory and collapsed back with SideFX's command-line tool (hotl -t / -l, or the current equivalent), and does an HDA collapsed from source text by Indie hotl still carry the limited-commercial tag? Can a minimal Python SOP HDA be authored entirely from text (no GUI save) and load in hython?
3. Python-SOP fallback: a shelf script creates a Python SOP whose code calls into python/a3ob_houdini and adds spare parameters. Prove that it cooks in hython, survives save/load of a .hip, and record what breaks when the package code updates (parameter-layout drift). Also cover where node logic must live so that either wrapper works (logic in python/ modules, wrapper thin).
4. A SOP-level output node with a 'Save to Disk' button (D10 export): how is this done in each option (button callback -> python module)?
5. Is a Python SOP / Python-based HDA available and functional in Apprentice? Docs only; just state the answer.
Constraints: do not install anything into the user's Houdini prefs; work in temp dirs and remove test HDAs/hips afterwards. Do not cd outside your worktree (Aesir 0.18.0 safety notice): use absolute paths. No GUI interaction is required; the GUI session with the houdini MCP may be used read-only if helpful.
title: HDA packaging spike: how Houdini nodes ship (D11)

spec:
Write docs/design/ux-tools.md: the user-facing design of the A3OB Houdini tools, from owner decisions D10 (node/shelf split, workflow) and D11 (shipping pending the packaging spike), consistent with the M2 data-model spec (task #3 rev 3: D7/D8/D9).
Must contain:
(a) For each node in D10 (P3D Import, Extract LOD, Assemble LODs, LOD Properties, Proxy, Material assign, Mass, Validate, P3D Export): purpose, inputs/outputs, the parameter list with defaults (including the export options that default off: lowercase, relative paths, sort sections, sort LODs, auto-components, selection mask '* ^__*'), the spec attributes it reads and writes, and how errors and warnings surface.
(b) Each shelf tool in D10: what it does and what it creates.
(c) Three walkthroughs, step by step: edit an existing p3d (the character sample) and re-export; build a simple model from 'New P3D'; fix a validator error.
(d) Which pieces map to M3 and which to M4, with an order of work. Node logic lives in python/a3ob_houdini; the wrappers stay thin so that HDA or Python-SOP shipping (D11) both work.
(e) Open UX questions for the owner, each with a recommendation.
Docs only; no code. Plain-language style per docs/practices.md comment-standard.

2. a3ob_houdini importer: builds the P3D container geometry from an a3ob_core P3DModel following spec section 16 and every attribute table: points and loose points, polygons with the section 4.3 corner map, prim strings and flags, N and UVs, groups and a3ob_w_*/a3ob_fw_* weights (default 1.0), blobs (section 11.2, incl. MaskTagg/AnimationTagg), sharp edges, detail attributes (a3ob_lod_signature, a3ob_source_counts as int32[3], a3ob_tagg_order, ...), a3ob_lod_uid from lod_uid(source_key, lod_index) per section 3.5, proxies as packed prims (path/index inside and outside, section 13), one packed prim per LOD with name, a3ob_file_trailing. Tests (stdlib unittest; tests that need hou skip under CPython): for both fixtures, every attribute in the spec tables matches the M1 model (counts; exact float32 positions after the axis map; normals; UVs; face flags; textures and materials; selections and weights; mass; properties; signatures; proxy prims with path and index; TAGG order; blobs). lod_uid is stable across recooks and differs between two import nodes. With HOUDINI_PATH including <repo>/houdini (set only in the test child process), the HDA loads in hython and cooks sample_1_character.p3d with no errors and the expected LOD count. Import time for sample_1 (5.3 MB) is reported.
5. quick gate passes (CPython 3.12 and hython 3.13).

spec:
Project root and presets tool: two fixes from the owner's shelf-tool walkthrough (2026-11-03).
1. Edit preset never saves on Cancel. Today the options step calls hou.ui.selectFromList without clear_on_cancel, and Houdini returns default_choices on Cancel (hou.ui.selectFromList docstring, Houdini 22.0.466), so Cancel saves the preset anyway. Clear_on_cancel=True alone is not enough: an empty tuple also means "Accept with nothing ticked", a valid all-off preset. Fix: after the options list, a confirm step (hou.ui.displayMessage with Save / Cancel) names the preset and lists the options that will be on (or "all off"); only Save writes. Cancel or closing any step writes nothing. Keep the hou.ui calls in project_settings_dialog.py thin: put the summary text and the "values from chosen indices" logic in a pure function so it can be tested headless.

spec:
Node QA pass (owner, 2026-11-03): per-node layout and UX changes from the owner's walkthrough of /obj/a3ob_node_zoo, plus plain-language tooltips everywhere. The advisor appends a section per node as the owner finishes it; do not start until the advisor says the list is complete. A. Generator support
A0. Houdini help (Help section, #33) fixes found by the advisor reading the live help server pages (nodes/sop/a3ob_p3d_export, a3ob_validate, a3ob_mass): (a) wiki markup is not escaped: the Selection Mask default "* ^__*" renders as bold/italic; escape *, _, and any other wiki markup characters in defaults, labels and help text (test: the rendered or generated text for selmask shows "* ^__*" literally; labels with an inner colon such as "T2-UV2: At most 2 UV sets" render as one label). (b) menu choices without their own help get the filler "Sets this to <label>."; drop the filler and give each choice real help (Z1). (c) inputs show the filler "Input 1."; give each input a one-line description from the node SPEC (input_labels plus text). (d) when a menu's tooltip is split into per-choice lines (Check: "Every cook: ..."), keep the parameter's own first sentence and start each choice line with a capital.
A1. Parm gains a visibility condition (Houdini hidewhen, and disablewhen if cheap), written by hda_source.py into the DialogScript; build_hdas.py --check and build_user_docs.py --check stay clean, and the generated reference pages say when a parameter is shown (for example "shown when Mode is Uniform total").

B. Mass (a3ob_mass)
B1. Replace the shared "value" parameter with three: mass_each "Mass per Point (kg)", mass_total "Total Mass (kg)", density "Density (kg/m³)" (internal names may differ; keep them stable afterwards). Each is shown only for its mode (Set on each / Uniform total / From density) and hidden for Clear / Copy from mass / Copy to mass. Defaults as today (1.0) unless the owner says otherwise; minimum 0, no maximum.
B2. Everything that sets or reads "value" moves to the new names: new_p3d.build_starter (Uniform total 100 kg), tests, docs/user generated reference, any preset or doc text.
B3. hython test: each mode reads only its own parameter; the hidden ones do not change the result.
B4. Old scenes keep their mass: a Mass node saved with the old "value" parameter loads with that value in the parameter of its mode (keep "value" as a hidden legacy parm read on cook, or migrate it on load; say which). hython test loads an old-style node and checks the cooked a3ob_mass.

C. P3D Import (a3ob_p3d_import)
C1. "File" tooltip: the owner did not know what "MLOD" means. Plain version, e.g.: "The .p3d model to open. Use the editable version Object Builder saves (MLOD). Files taken out of the game's packed PBOs (binarized, ODOL) can't be opened." The error for an ODOL file says the same in plain words.
C3. "LODs" needs the user to know the file's LOD order. Add a toggle menu (Houdini menutoggle on the string parm, via the existing menu_action mechanism) filled from the chosen file's LOD list by display name with its index ("0  Resolution 1", "5  Geometry"); picking an entry adds or removes its index in the field. Read only what is needed to list the LODs, so large files stay quick (state how long it takes on the largest Arma 3 Samples file, Test_Plane_01.p3d, 12 MB). The field also accepts LOD display names and * patterns ("Geometry Memory", "Resolution*"), case-insensitive, alongside numbers and ranges. Tooltip: "Which LODs to bring in. Pick them from the menu, or type numbers or names. * means all." hython tests for the menu items and for name/pattern selection; an unknown name is a clear warning.
C2. "Explicit Face Groups" tooltip explains in plain words what a face group is and when you would want one for every selection.

D. Material Assign (a3ob_material_assign)
D1. Set Texture / Set Material tooltips say what the box is for and what each state does, e.g. "On: this node gives the polygons the texture chosen below. Off: the polygons keep the texture they already have (from the file or an earlier node), for example when you only want to change the material." (Material: same pattern.)
D2. Texture File becomes a file picker (patterns *.paa *.tga *.png, read mode); Material File becomes a file picker (*.rvmat). Slash handling and the export's relative-path option are unchanged; the tooltip says the export makes the path relative to the project root.
D3. Color becomes a colour picker with alpha (Houdini colour parm, RGBA). Generator support for a colour kind if needed (A section). Old scenes keep their colour value (same parm name, or migrate as in B4).
D4. Rename for meaning (internal names may stay): Texture Source choice "Custom" -> "Custom texture text"; "Raw Text" -> "Texture Text", tooltip: what a texture line is, with an example procedural (#(argb,8,8,3)color(1,0,0,1,CO)) and that it is copied exactly; "Common Procedural" -> "Pick a Common Texture" (copies a frequently used texture line from the common data file into Texture Text and switches the source to Custom texture text); "Add Common" -> "Pick a Common Material".
D5. Visibility (needs A1): Texture File only for source File; Color and Color Type only for Color; Texture Text and Pick a Common Texture only for Custom texture text. All texture fields disabled when Set Texture is off; Material File and Pick a Common Material disabled when Set Material is off.
D6. Tests: hython checks the parm kinds (file, colour), the hide/disable conditions per state, and that cooking with each source still writes the same a3ob_texture as before.

E. Proxy (a3ob_proxy)
E1. Path becomes a file picker (*.p3d, read mode). A picked absolute path (P:\a3\data_f\proxies\weapon_slots\top.p3d) gives the same proxy name as typing the P-drive path: .p3d dropped and / as \ (as today), and made relative to the project root on export when that option is on. Tooltip says so. hython test with a picked-style absolute path.

F. LOD Properties (a3ob_lod_properties)
F1. Owner layout (exact dialog script saved at exportTests/hda_sandbox/owner/a3ob_lod_properties.ds): the "props" multiparm sits inside a Simple folder (group box) labelled "Properties", and the "copies" multiparm inside a Simple folder labelled "LOD Copies". Everything else unchanged. Give the folders stable names (e.g. props_box, copies_box; the owner's were auto-named folder0/folder1).
F2. Generator support (A section): a folder kind in params.Parm (Simple / Collapsible / Tabs) with children, written by hda_source.py, shown as headings in the HTML reference and the Help section. read_parms and every node's cook ignore folders.
F3. Test: the generated a3ob_lod_properties definition's parm template tree matches the owner's (folder types, labels, children order), compared structurally, not as text.

G. P3D Export (a3ob_p3d_export)
G1. Owner-approved layout (exact dialog script: exportTests/hda_sandbox/owner/a3ob_p3d_export_proposal.ds; the owner's own first draft is a3ob_p3d_export.ds beside it). Top level: Output File, Save to Disk, Keep a .bak. Then tabs (Houdini Tabs folders) in this order: "Error Checking" (check, errorlevel, strict, dupes, maxmessages), "Presets" (preset, apply), "Paths & Names" (relpaths, projectroot, lowercase, czech, renumber), "Selections" (selmask, autocomponents), "File Layout" (sortlods, sortsections, dropuvs), "LOD Rules" (typerules, then every rule switch). Folder names stable: tab_checking, tab_presets, tab_paths, tab_selections, tab_layout, tab_rules. Parameter names unchanged.
G2. Rule switch labels drop the "T2-XXX: " prefix ("At most 2 UV sets"); the rule id moves to the end of the tooltip ("(Rule T2-UV2.)") and stays in messages and docs where it helps searching.
G3. Validate gets the same "Error Checking" and "LOD Rules" tabs, built from the same shared parm lists (_export_common.level_parms / rule_parms), so the two nodes cannot drift.
G4. Project Root becomes a folder picker (Houdini directory chooser); empty still means the shelf settings root, then P:\.
G5. Selection Mask UX: keep the field and its syntax, add a toggle menu listing the input's point groups by decoded P3D name (picking one adds or removes it in the mask, like Houdini group fields), and an info line on the node "N selections will be written" (per LOD or total). Plain tooltip: "Which point groups become selections in the file. Leave as is to write all of them except Houdini's internal ones (names starting with __)." Test the menu items and the count line.
G6. Owner D26: a newly created P3D Export node starts from the active preset of the Project root and presets settings (an OnCreated step that applies it, so the HDA's parameter defaults and old scenes are unchanged); with no settings file it starts from Lossless. New P3D's starter export does the same. The Preset menu shows which preset was applied. hython test with a temp settings file whose active preset is Arma 3 release, and with none.

Z. Tooltips (after all node sections)
Z1. Every parameter of every A3OB node has a tooltip in plain words: what it does, in one or two short sentences, units where there are any, and for menus what each choice does. No internal ids, no spec references. Tooltips the owner typed in the sandbox are kept word for word.
Z2. Shelf tool helpText is rewritten for users (no "The work is in ..." developer notes).
Z3. A test fails if any A3OB parameter (multiparm children included) has an empty tooltip.

Gate: scripts/build_hdas.py --check and scripts/build_user_docs.py --check are clean after the SPEC changes; labels quoted in the #28 guides are updated to match; quick gate passes on CPython 3.12 and hython 3.13. Runs after #28 merges.

spec:
Fix F-4 from #29 (correctness bug): after the importer reorders interleaved proxy points and faces (spec 13.6), point- and face-index data kept as file indices goes stale and lands on other points: the #Selected# mask bytes (6 LODs in the Arma 3 Samples) and the sharp pairs kept in a3ob_sharp_extra (15 LODs).
1. Every count-bound or index-bound record the importer keeps (mask TAGGs, #Selected#, #Hide#, a3ob_sharp_extra pairs, and any other blob that stores point or face numbers; list them in the task log with the spec section) is remapped through the import permutation, so after import it refers to the same points and faces as in the file. Anything that cannot be remapped is dropped with a warning naming the LOD and the record, never kept pointing at other points.
2. Export writes them back through the inverse mapping where the export restores the file order; otherwise in the order the export writes the points.
3. Tests: a synthetic file with interleaved proxies plus a #Selected# mask and sharp pairs that touch both proxy and non-proxy points: after import every masked or sharp point is the same point (by position) as in the file; after a Lossless export and re-read, the same. The #29 Samples test (tests/test_real_file_layout.py F-4 pin) is updated on purpose; on the Samples, the 6 mask LODs and 15 sharp-pair LODs are content-correct (same points by position).
4. quick gate passes on CPython 3.12 and hython 3.13; the samples profile passes where the Samples exist.
Runs before the byte-lossless layout task (D23), which builds on the permutation.
title: Fix F-4: remap index-bound blobs through the interleaved-proxy permutation

spec:
Byte-identical round trips for real Object Builder files (owner D23). #29 found 30/34 Arma 3 Samples files differ after Import > Lossless export only by file layout: F-1 normal table (duplicate entries), F-2 unused fourth slot of triangle records, F-3 sharp pair order (incl. (a, a) pairs), F-4 interleaved proxy order, F-5 signed zero (docs/design/evidence/samples/samples_findings.md).
1. Spec first: a new spec section (and spec 14 data-model update) for a per-LOD layout record: what it holds (normal table and corner indices, unused-slot values, sharp pair list and order, point and face permutation of interleaved proxies, signed-zero bits, anything else needed), how it is stored (a hidden detail or prim attribute on the LOD, e.g. base64 bytes, named with the a3ob_ prefix and documented), and when it is valid: bound to the point, face and corner counts and a cheap checksum of positions and topology it was taken from, like the other count-bound blobs. When the LOD was edited so the record no longer matches, the export ignores it and writes today's content-lossless layout, with an info line saying so (never a wrong file).
2. Build it: importer writes the record, exporter uses it when valid. Extract LOD and Assemble LODs carry it unchanged. The record is never shown as a selection or user attribute in normal use.
3. Tests: synthetic repros for F-1..F-5 now give identical bytes; an edit (move one point, delete a face) invalidates the record and gives a valid content-lossless file; samples profile: 34/34 Samples files sha256-identical after Import > Lossless export and after Import > Extract LOD (all) > Assemble > Lossless. The fixtures stay identical. Record the import/export time change on Male.p3d.
4. Docs: concepts page "Lossless round trips" explains in plain words what stays byte-identical and when it falls back.
5. quick gate passes on CPython 3.12 and hython 3.13; build_hdas/build_user_docs --check clean.
Runs after the F-4 fix.
title: Byte-identical round trips for Object Builder files: per-LOD layout record (D23)

spec:
